label.purpose: Label of the switch that turns on reading rekordbox's library database. It never changes with the state.
label.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, the switch's label.

helpOff.purpose: Help under the switch while it is off: the collection comes from the XML export.
helpOff.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, under the switch while off.

helpOn.purpose: Help under the switch while it is on: a copy is read, the database is never changed, and sending still needs an XML export.
helpOn.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, under the switch while on.

keyLabel.purpose: Label of the password field where the user types the database key.
keyLabel.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, above the key field while on.

keySet.purpose: Says a key was typed in this run of the app; the key itself is never shown.
keySet.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, under the key field once a key is kept.

pick.purpose: Button that opens the file picker to choose rekordbox's database file.
pick.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, button while on.

fileFilter.purpose: Name of the file type filter in the picker.
fileFilter.where: File picker opened from the database row.

picked.purpose: Shows which database file was picked.
picked.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, under the buttons once a file is picked.

read.purpose: Button that reads the picked database now.
read.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, button while on.

reading.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, status line during a read.

done_one.purpose: Status after a read: how many tracks were read.
done_one.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, status line after a successful read.

done_other.purpose: Status after a read: how many tracks were read.
done_other.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, status line after a successful read.

error.purpose: A change to the switch failed.
error.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, under the row after a failed save.

failure.turnedOff.purpose: Why the newest read failed or did not start (turnedOff).
failure.turnedOff.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, status line after a failed read.

failure.noKey.purpose: Why the newest read failed or did not start (noKey).
failure.noKey.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, status line after a failed read.

failure.notFound.purpose: Why the newest read failed or did not start (notFound).
failure.notFound.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, status line after a failed read.

failure.cantRead.purpose: Why the newest read failed or did not start (cantRead).
failure.cantRead.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, status line after a failed read.

failure.wrongKey.purpose: Why the newest read failed or did not start (wrongKey).
failure.wrongKey.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, status line after a failed read.

failure.damaged.purpose: Why the newest read failed or did not start (damaged).
failure.damaged.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, status line after a failed read.

failure.notALibrary.purpose: Why the newest read failed or did not start (notALibrary).
failure.notALibrary.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, status line after a failed read.

failure.stopped.purpose: Why the newest read failed or did not start (stopped).
failure.stopped.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, database row, status line after a failed read.
